A holder of the deterrent is not attacke: A holder of the deterrent is not attacked directly by another holder, and its wars with other holders end in limited terms: liberation and money, never conquest. Acquisition is research, not decree.
A war nobody can win and nobody can stop: A war nobody can win and nobody can stop: air raid drills in the metro, iodine in the pharmacy, and both capitals one radar ghost away from the end of the world.
